name: Volkswagen Financial Services Braunschweig-Rautheim data center
notes: CIO.de reported VW Financial Services put its third Braunschweig data center into operation after a two-year build; investment about EUR65m, over 2,000 sqm, with expansion option to 5,000 sqm.

name: Rheinmetall Unterluess central data center
notes: AZ-online reported topping-out in 2022 for a modular high-security central group data center at Rheinmetall's Unterluess site, planned for commissioning by year-end 2022 and sized for several thousand servers/network components.

name: Rheinmetall Hermannsburg data center
notes: Same Rheinmetall program included a second data center planned at Hermannsburg, about 15 km from Unterluess, with commissioning targeted for Q1 2023; total cost for both buildings and IT infrastructure was described as low-to-mid double-digit millions of euros.

name: RZ-OM Cloppenburg data center capacity expansion
notes: Company history says it expanded its data center with capacities at the Cloppenburg site in 2024 after WebServ-IT transferred its data center; work included modernization and central monitoring.

name: Garrel energy and industry park IT campus
notes: German Datacenter Association partner profile quotes Garrel's mayor welcoming data center industry interest in establishing an IT campus tied to an energy/industry park at Garrel-Ost; GDA newsletter says the municipality is pushing development of the park.

name: Sylatex Cuxhaven virtualized data center
notes: Company site states Sylatex operates a fully virtualized data center at its Cuxhaven location for cloud storage, backups, databases, DMS applications, and hosted IT environments.

name: Stadt Delmenhorst municipal data center
notes: Kita-Portal imprint/search snippet states the city portal is processed via order processing and in the data center of the City of Delmenhorst; no further facility details or capacity found.

name: dc2share Wagenfeld green data center
developer: dc2share GmbH & Co. KG / Wagenfelder Energie Grundstücksgesellschaft
notes: Planned first project on former Patriot military site in Wagenfeld-Foerlingen; concept by dc2share, powered mainly by local renewables. Developer said plans should be concretized in 2026 with building application targeted for Q4 and initial scale 5-10 MW, growing over ten years.

name: Deutsche Telekom edge data center at Volkswagen Emden port terminal
notes: DCD reported Deutsche Telekom deployed a 5G network and edge data center at Volkswagen's Emden port terminal to host the Unikie Marshalling Solution for the AutoLog autonomous car logistics project.

name: Landkreis Emsland Meppen municipal data center
notes: Construction started on a new municipal data center addition at the Meppen district administration building; completion expected by end-2027, total cost EUR3.4m, no disclosed power capacity.

name: DiaServ Gifhorn data center
notes: DiaServ's site lists a Rechenzentrum in Gifhorn, over 5,000 users in service, around 300 supported sites, and its visitor address at Am Hagen 2, 38518 Gifhorn; no capacity disclosed.
